purpose.description: diagnostic records an explicitly non-accepting baseline before readiness; omitted/grading retains normal acceptance and instrument gates.

barSetHash.description: Reviewed BAR set digest. Diagnostics retain and re-check this exact identity.

pendingDeliveryBarKeys.description: Explicit pre-publication review: named manual instrument:none deployed/live BARs must rate unknown. Defers only their delivery proof at pre-grading; final ship still requires it. Omit for ordinary grading.

gradingLaunch.description: Audit launch pin: codex/gpt-6.1-sol/xhigh, account auto; same strict profile as repair. Author/authority unchanged.

interactionReviewerHandle.description: CRM review receipt; identifies the terminal reviewer independently of the app caller.

rubricRevision.description: Reviewed rubric revision; null pins unversioned; refuse on change.

criteriaHash.description: Reviewed criterion fingerprint; null pins unavailable. Refuse on change.

rubricMeaningRevision.description: Reviewed acceptance meaning epoch; null means absent. Refuse on change.

sourceHive.description: Producing/grader hive; defaults to caller. For cross-hive grading put the subject plan's hive in targetHive.

targetHive.description: Subject plan/repository hive for deterministic checks. Independent of sourceHive.

harness.description: Subject harness; sets targetHive. Refused if it differs.

ratings.description: Complete ratings; acceptanceOf may adopt the exact independent card verbatim.

evidenceRef.description: Stable reference for the artifact or probe named by `evidence`. For a grading-integrity replay challenge, pair it with `evidenceKind` and cite a reference outside the graded card's replay selection; the guard checks selection membership, not the referenced content.

evidenceKind.description: Kind or namespace for `evidenceRef` (for example `test-run`). For a grading-integrity replay challenge, both fields are required to establish that evidence is outside the graded card's replay selection.

unknownReason.description: not-assessed = you have not graded it yet; instrument-unavailable = a measurement failed

testedSha.description: Actually tested SHA; required for releaseGating pass-like ratings. Must equal fresh green pin AND staging HEAD.

acceptance.description: An author acceptance verdict's persisted card always carries complete ratings, supplied directly or adopted from the exact independent card via acceptanceOf. Independent graders omit the verdict. accept-pending-delivery means only unreachable live/deployed proof remains; it preserves its proof/blocker obligation.

acceptanceOf.description: With acceptance, adopts its ratings verbatim from the exact independent card named here after checking independence, completeness and revision; source grader provenance is preserved. Omit to use the first qualifying card.

provenance.description: Default self-reported: caller-derived numbers; verdict comparison checks your own assertion. Only deterministic platform instruments may claim platform-computed.

fromLedger.description: Rate probe/instrument-checked criteria from their latest results-ledger rows; rate only the rest.

ledgerDispositions.description: With fromLedger: remediation/disregard and optional evidence for calibration or subject context. Context is appended to ledger evidence; the rating and measurement stay ledger-owned.

current.description: Fresh fingerprints as plans:get current; non-code outcomes require them. Omission stays unknown.

harness.description: Concrete in-scope harness slug (e.g. papercusp); harness-scoped sessions infer it. all requires unscoped --all-workspaces. Only UNSCOPED plans:get/plans:items auto-resolve an exact slug across harnesses; scoped misses identify the owning harness, which you must then pass explicitly.

scorecardId.description: Replay a persisted spec-test-adequacy scorecard from its stored recipe and creation-time evidence. Pair with that recipe’s plan slug; do not combine with direct evaluation selectors.

classRef.description: Derived from the persisted subject acceptance class when omitted; a supplied value must match. Ad-hoc work items still need explicit class attestation.

specRevision.description: Immutable clause revision pin. Supply together with specFingerprint; both are required when replaySnapshot is true.

specFingerprint.description: Immutable clause fingerprint pin. Supply together with specRevision; both are required when replaySnapshot is true.

replaySnapshot.description: When true, grade the pinned immutable clause revision instead of the live one. Requires both specRevision and specFingerprint from the same immutable clause revision. Normal evaluator calls still re-measure bindings with persisted recipes; the grading auditor uses a separate internal historical replay to reproduce the card’s emission-time verdict.

current.description: Caller-supplied fingerprints may be the canonical array or the persisted rerunRecipe.current wrapper; wrapper.supplied:false and boolean true/false omit caller fingerprints and use independent server measurement. In normal evaluator calls, matching caller values remain unknown and cannot produce freshness:pass; the internal grading-audit replay uses them only with the card’s historical cutoff to reproduce its original verdict.

limit.description: Evidence-row limit across filtered scope (not clauses), default/max1000. Reaching it refuses with evidence_selection_hit_limit and no verdict: cohort may be truncated. Omit, increase within max, or narrow selectors.

detail.description: Response size. Default 'summary' (or false) returns a compact verdict table plus a fullBody ref; 'full' (or true) returns the complete body (evidence text, drafts, criteria prose).

criteria.description: Return ratings for only these criteria; verdict, wouldBlock and verdicts still cover every criterion. With detail:"full" it omits scorecardDraft (a partial draft cannot be emitted).

subject.description: observation.subject; rubric vetting uses kind:'rubric',ref:rubricId. Acceptance default=subjectPlan; explicit wins.

authorHandoffId.description: Existing exact-identity author obligation returned by an author-only refusal. Pickup and settlement recheck current authority.

gradingAuditReservation.description: Pending audit lease from the brief; invalid lease refuses. Omit only for unreserved legacy or settled-audit corrections.

vettingUnanswered.description: No critique assertion; needs consult+reason, refuses existing critique. Recorded as observation.vetting.unanswered waiver, not approval.

vettingUnansweredReason.description: Measured absent critique (ended reviewers/expired consult/zero posts), beyond 'no reply yet'.

supersedes.description: Corrected card id. Only explicit corrections supersede prior readings; ordinary measurements and baseline regrades preserve history.

baselineRef.description: Audited pre-repair baseline, preserved for comparable re-grade with same target/pinned rubric; never replaced.

terminal.description: Subject ended. Otherwise violatable ratings are provisional and excluded from rubrics:trend. Finalize with terminal:true and supersedes the interim.

force.description: File even when the canonical evidence fingerprint matches the latest scorecard.

acknowledgeExisting.description: Required to append when complete independent cards exist at this revision. force only bypasses unchanged-evidence dedup; it never replaces acknowledgement.

vettingConsult.description: Meta-rubric vetting consult for subject:{kind:'rubric',ref}. Rubric must exist; opening question identifies rubric/plan and has a third-party reply. Exactly one of vettingConsult/vettingWorkItem.
